definitions.explanation: Each and every week; weekly. Used to express something that happens on a weekly basis. Functions as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{土曜日|どようび}にテニスをします。
{毎週|まいしゅう}{日本語|にほんご}のクラスがあります。
examples.english: I have Japanese class every week.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{二|に}{回|かい}{ジム|じむ}に{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the gym twice every week.

notes: Combines {毎|まい} (every) with {週|しゅう} (week). Often used with days of the week to indicate regular schedules. Related expressions include {先週|せんしゅう} (last week), {今週|こんしゅう} (this week), and {来週|らいしゅう} (next week).
